text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fu-chan's
Fashion Advice♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"The day you start something new
always takes a little bit of courage, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"In that case!
Why don't you try drawing power from fashion?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "I might pick up colors I wouldn't normally choose, or try on clothes with slightly bolder cutouts..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With just a slight change,
I'm sure you can wear courage too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, have confidence in yourself.
You can definitely... shine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After deciding to run through the Twinkle Series alongside North Flight, a horse girl who absolutely loves fashion—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm...
Hmm, hmm.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
please rest assured!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's a very lovely outfit!
It's neat and gives a very clean impression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we were going out together today,
I asked for an opinion on the outfit
I put together myself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Just one thing. Maybe it could use a little more of a relaxed, effortless feel!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By deliberately keeping part of it casual,
it adds a light, breezy impression.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As for a very simple way to do it...
Pardon me, I'll take your sleeve.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —If I roll up the sleeves a bit casually like this...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hey, doesn't this feel
a little more relaxing?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Looking good♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... you thought
you had to do everything properly
since you were going to greet them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I understand your feelings completely.
So, you can relax your shoulders a bit!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's go!
—To where "Onee-chan" is!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Um, it should be around here—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found you~.
Big sis~!

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
Fu-chan, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is North Flight's "big sister"...
though not by blood; she was her Trainer
back when she belonged to a development club.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Orange eyeshadow!
Could that be...

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
It's the birthday present Fu-chan gave me.
I figured today would be the day to wear it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really suits you so well!
...Wait.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
From the way you're talking,
is today your first day on the job?

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
"It was so lovely that I treasured it dearly.
It sparkled just like the desert at dusk."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
!!
I thought so too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I wanted to give it to you, Big Sis!
Ehehe, it's so pretty, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In front of "Big Sis," North Flight acts a bit younger.
Though she is usually dependable, she can let her guard down and be pampered before the "older sister" she trusts.
choice_data_list: (I need to pull myself together, too!)

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
...So, Fuu-chan.
You're gonna show me today, right?

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
Your brilliance, polished together
with your trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meeting up with "Big Sister" today was...
to show her North Flight's current running,
and the possibilities that have expanded.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Today, I'll be running at 1,600m.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text: A mile, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sprint route at 1,600m and below,
the classic route from 2,000m to 2,500m,
the ultra-long-distance route at 3,000m and above...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Among those options, North Flight set her sights on the sprint route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, drawing a clear line at sprints up to 1400m—
she decided to center her challenges primarily around the mile.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Watch me, Onee-chan. Watch me—shine!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight sprints past her 'older sister.' She's holding back because the final stretch――
is the single moment she will stake everything on.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
...!!
What incredible speed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance North Flight displayed on the home stretch... that speed was simply dazzling.
Her weapon is pure, unadulterated "speed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What brought that out best,
and what 'suited' her best—was the mile."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! 
Haa... urgh...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... I-I'm fine.
I'm not pushing myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Truly, it's so endearingly
difficult to manage... this "body" of mine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her overwhelming talent, North Flight struggled
with a delicate constitution. Because of that,
she couldn't undergo hard training just yet.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Still, I gave it everything I had right now. How did I do, Big Sis—

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
...Fu-chan.
May I touch your head?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis" tenderly strokes North Flight's head
with a caring touch.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
You're able to sustain your full power longer than before.
It's proof of just how hard you've worked.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
Back when you were in the development club...
you were so frail,
you struggled just to run a little bit.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text: All the girls around us kept growing so fast... There were times we felt left behind, weren't there?

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text: Still, you never gave up.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Lamenting what I was born with won't carve out a path. Even if I couldn't love myself, I can never separate myself from "who I am."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'll find the coordination that brings out my raw potential best.
So that I can come to truly love... 'myself'—"

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
—And so, you found it.
A coordinate that is uniquely yours.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
1,600m――the mile.
That is the best outfit for me to wear.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
Fu-chan.
You're really... okay, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That simple question seemed to carry far more emotion
than the words alone conveyed.
I wonder if North Flight felt it too—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: I'll always be there to support you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
...That's true.
If it's the two of them, they'll surely be fine.

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
"Because you two...
are such a 'perfect match.'"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye, Big Sis!
I'll be in touch again~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Right then!
Trainer, what are you doing after this?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"There are some new releases I want to check out,
so I think I'll go do some shopping."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since I'd be walking alongside such a fashion-loving girl from here on out, I had been thinking I'd like to learn more about fashion little by little...
choice_data_list: Do you mind if I come along?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing!
Are you looking for something?
choice_data_list: Like... the outfit to wear for your debut race?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
How lovely♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's fine, but...
Unlike Umamusume, Trainers don't really have a dress code, do they?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In the mood to get a whole new matching set, maybe?
Or perhaps—
choice_data_list: I want to become a Trainer who suits you even better.
I want to become a trainer more worthy of you

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood!
In that case!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let me suggest
the absolute perfect outfits
for you and me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, days of training with North Flight, first aimed at her debut, began!
